vi: Chọn Firestore Native cho mobile/web realtime (document DB, realtime listener, offline-first SDK), Bigtable cho time-series throughput cao (wide-column, row-key scan).
Phân biệt Firestore Native (FIRESTORE_NATIVE type realtime) vs Datastore mode (legacy, không realtime, chỉ để đối chiếu).
Thiết kế Bigtable schema qua row-key engineering để tránh hotspot (không có secondary index, chỉ row-key range scan).
Hiểu access pattern quyết định data store: subscribe-document pattern → Firestore, scan-by-rowkey pattern → Bigtable.
Khai báo Bigtable capacity qua cluster { num_nodes } thay vì một "tier" enum, hiểu scaling horizontal qua node count.
en: Choose Firestore Native for mobile/web realtime (document DB, realtime listener, offline-first SDK), Bigtable for high-throughput time-series (wide-column, row-key scan).
Distinguish Firestore Native (FIRESTORE_NATIVE type, realtime) from Datastore mode (legacy, no realtime, reference only).
Design Bigtable schema via row-key engineering to avoid hotspots (no secondary indexes, only row-key range scan).
Understand access patterns drive data store choice: subscribe-document pattern → Firestore, scan-by-rowkey pattern → Bigtable.
Declare Bigtable capacity via cluster { num_nodes } instead of an enum "tier", understanding horizontal scaling via node count.
